done.label: Done / proven
done.meaning: Implemented and supported by relevant tests or proofs.

in-progress.label: In progress
in-progress.meaning: Shell or foundation exists, but placement/functionality/proof coverage is incomplete.

not-implemented.label: Not implemented
not-implemented.meaning: Documented requirement exists, but there is no working implementation yet.

elements.label: Shared V2 page wrapper
elements.summary: Reusable V2 shell foundation that owns sidebar/main layout and shared event-history placement.

elements.label: V2 Event history panel
elements.summary: Reuses the existing event-history renderer and copy/clear actions inside V2 pages.

elements.label: V2 status/help metadata foundation
elements.summary: Structured metadata backing future Explain controls, Explain values, and Implementation status overlays.
